While the animal_pose_auditor reported 'MINIMAL' risk with high confidence keypoints, this is likely due to the model's difficulty in resolving small, occluded limbs in grass, leading it to 'guess' plausible positions rather than detect true structure. The visual evidence of the paw merging into the grass/fur supports the Router's assessment of structural ambiguity/melting. The 'texture_anomaly' in the grass (Severity 1.5) and 'perspective_distortion' in the log (Severity 1.0) are also valid, subtle AI artifacts. The perceptual_quality_auditor's finding of 'slight compression' (0.2) aligns with the general softness/grain of the image. I agree with the Router's severity ratings; they are conservative but appropriate for subtle generative artifacts.

Additionally, the background grass shows slight texture blending/melting (Severity 1.5), and the log in the background has minor geometric warping (Severity 1.0). These issues prevent a perfect artifact score but do not constitute catastrophic failure. The scores are calibrated against Reference 2 (mid-quality hammerhead with some artifacts) and Reference 3 (high-quality bird), placing this weasel image slightly below the high-quality reference due to the limb ambiguity.
